hero.subtitle: Drop any selfie — VisaPass detects 468 facial landmarks, removes the background in a Web Worker, and crops to the exact ratio your country requires. All on your device.

upload.title: Drop a photo, or click to upload
upload.hint: JPG / PNG / HEIC · up to 25 MB · processed entirely on your device
upload.errorType: Please upload a JPG, PNG, WebP, or HEIC photo.
upload.errorSize: That file is {size} — please use a photo under 25 MB.

features.heading: Engineered to pass on first submission
features.subtitle: Every pixel is computed against the issuing authority's spec — head ratio, eye-line position, and background color.

landmarks.title: 468 facial landmarks
landmarks.body: MediaPipe Face Landmarker locks onto chin, crown, and eye line for math-precise compliance — not vibes-based cropping.

bgswap.title: High-res background swap
bgswap.body: We process at the equivalent of 600 DPI in a Web Worker so hair strands and shoulders stay sharp before downscaling.

presets.title: 20+ country presets
presets.body: Schengen, US 2×2, UK 35×45, Canada 50×70, India 2×2, China 33×48 and many more — head ratios pre-encoded.

validation.title: Real-time validation
validation.body: Confidence score, glasses-policy hints, and live warnings if your upload is too low-res to meet specifications.

privacy.title: Stays on your device
privacy.body: No server upload by default — photos only leave your browser if you order physical prints via Stripe.

print.title: Print-ready output
print.body: Download an ICAO-compliant JPEG and a 4×6” glossy-printer sheet at 300 DPI to print at any pharmacy.

countryShowcase.heading: Country-perfect, every time
countryShowcase.subtitle: Each preset encodes head height ranges, eye line, glasses policy, and background tone.

editorPage.uploadSubtitle: Any well-lit, front-facing photo works. We'll handle the technical compliance.
